comment: Performance budgets enforced by scripts/perf-baseline.mjs against the local test build (mobile, simulated throttling, third-party vendors blocked). Calibrated 2026-09-14 from the baseline in docs/TESTING.md: LCP 2.7-3.6s, FCP ~0.95s, CLS 0, TBT 30-535ms (noisy), TTFB <20ms, JS 189-345KB, images 21-249KB, total 303-583KB per route. Error = must not regress meaningfully; warn = investigate. Tighten deliberately; never loosen to silence a real regression.
